credits.overview: Can scandalous art still serve God? Does suffering precede all greatness? Can illness be a blessing? In 1950, writer Flannery O'Connor visits her mother Regina in Georgia when she is diagnosed with lupus at twenty-four years old. Struggling with the same disease that took her father’s life when she was a child and desperate to make her mark as a great writer, this crisis pitches her imagination into a feverish exploration of belief.

credits.title: Absolution
credits.overview: An aging ex-boxer gangster working as muscle for a Boston crime boss receives an upsetting diagnosis.  Despite a faltering memory, he attempts to rectify the sins of his past and reconnect with his estranged children. He is determined to leave a positive legacy for his grandson, but the criminal underworld isn’t done with him and won’t loosen their grip willingly.

credits.title: David Frost Vs
credits.overview: Drawing from Frost's archive of more than 10,000 era-defining interviews, many of which have been lost for a generation, the documentary takes viewers on an immersive journery through the most important moments of the late 20th century via Frost's personal and revealing conversations with the protagonists, with striking parallels to today.

credits.title: Conan O'Brien Must Go
credits.overview: Conan O'Brien visits new friends he met through his podcast, "Conan O'Brien Needs a Fan," where he dives deep with listeners from across the country and the world.

credits.title: Ice Road: Vengeance
credits.overview: Big rig ice road driver Mike McCann travels to Nepal to scatter his late brother’s ashes on Mt. Everest. While on a packed tour bus traversing the deadly 12,000 ft. terrain of the infamous Road to the Sky, McCann and his mountain guide encounter a group of mercenaries and must fight to save themselves, the busload of innocent travelers, and the local villagers’ homeland.

credits.title: The Naked Gun
credits.overview: Only one man has the particular set of skills... to lead Police Squad and save the world: Lt. Frank Drebin Jr. Following in his father's footsteps, he must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from closure.

credits.title: Irvine Welsh: Reality Is Not Enough
credits.overview: One of the most controversial writers of our times, join Trainspotting author Irvine Welsh as he undergoes a remarkable trip to find new meaning in his work, life and legacy.

credits.title: Cold Storage
credits.overview: When a mutating, highly contagious fungus escapes a sealed facility, two employees – joined by a grizzled bioterror operative – must survive the wildest night shift ever to save humanity from extinction.

credits.title: Running Wild: Return to the River
credits.overview: Pacific salmon swim upstream on their homeward journey, bearing witness to the interconnected web of life linking land and sea.

credits.title: The Fix
credits.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

credits.title: The Late Late Show
credits.overview: Chat show that looks at current affairs in Ireland.

credits.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
credits.overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

credits.title: The Mongoose
credits.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

credits.title: 4 Kids Walk Into a Bank
credits.overview: After losing her mother, Paige's grandfather steps into to become a more responsible guardian. But when a group of criminals show up at their door demanding that Paige's grandpa join them for one last job, she's faced with a decision: let her newly reformed grandpa dip back into his criminal ways, or enlist her three best friends to do the job first.

credits.title: Believe 13
credits.overview: Legendary coach and trainer Jack Blatherwick, a key figure in the U.S.’s Winter Olympics 'Miracle on Ice' victory, helps a budding hockey star after the teen suffers a catastrophic injury.

credits.title: Charlie Johnson in the Flames
credits.overview: A political thriller about an American journalist who travels to Africa to hunt down a murderous Colonel and bring him to justice.

credits.title: Cold Pursuit 2
credits.overview: A sequel to the 2019 film Cold Pursuit.

credits.title: Evolution - Darwin's Dangerous Idea
credits.overview: This magazine-style documentary outlines biological evolution through a variety of dramatizations and data delivered by expert testimony.

credits.title: The Riker's Ghost
credits.overview: A convict set for release is forced to break a terrorist out of prison.

credits.title: The Splendid Thing
credits.overview: Celebrated novelist Declan King has lost his focus and has been struggling to complete his latest novel since his wife left him. He’s sent by his exasperated literary agent on a book-signing tour to Europe, where it’s hoped he may find inspiration to write, but things soon take a surreal turn as characters from his previous books start coming to life all around him.

credits.title: The Trainer
credits.overview: A premier horse trainer in the west of Ireland is beset by tragedy, loses everything he cherishes, and almost forgets to live. Into his life comes a teenage refugee who has fled her own horrors and now finds herself in a confounding new world. Their only connection to themselves, and ultimately to their own hearts, is a horse called Allabelle, who is about to prove that they may all have one race left inside of them.
